# Addicta: The Turkish Journal on Addictions

> A peer-reviewed, open-access Turkish academic journal dedicated to multidisciplinary addiction research, publishing original articles, reviews, and editorials on substance abuse, behavioral addictions, and clinical interventions.

Addicta is an internationally recognized Turkish journal based in Istanbul that publishes high-quality addiction research following ICMJE and COPE standards. The journal serves researchers, clinicians, and professionals across multiple disciplines including medicine, psychology, criminology, and public health.

## Key Topics

- Addiction research
- Peer-reviewed journal
- Publication ethics

## Journal Overview

- [Addicta: The Turkish Journal on Addictions](https://addicta.com.tr): Homepage for Addicta, a peer-reviewed open-access Turkish journal on addiction research
- [About the Journal](https://addicta.com.tr/about): Information about Addicta journal's mission, scope, and multidisciplinary focus on addictions
- [Editorial Board](https://addicta.com.tr/editorialBoard): Editorial board and leadership team for Addicta journal including Editor-in-Chief

## Current Issues & Articles

- [Vol. 13 No. 1 (2026)](https://addicta.com.tr/issue/current): Current issue of Addicta featuring peer-reviewed articles on addiction research topics
- [Early View](https://addicta.com.tr/issue/view/earlyView): Early View section with peer-reviewed articles published ahead of issue compilation
- [Interventions for adolescent digital addiction: A narrative review (2013–2023)](https://addicta.com.tr/article/view/32): Narrative review of interventions for adolescent digital addiction and internet use
- [E-cigarette use, thirdhand smoke awareness, and motivation to participate in physical activity in adolescents](https://addicta.com.tr/article/view/29): Cross-sectional study on e-cigarette use and physical activity motivation in adolescents
- [Multidisciplinary work and ethical approaches in rehabilitation services](https://addicta.com.tr/article/view/477): Editorial on ethical approaches in addiction rehabilitation services by Hakan Coşkunol

## Author & Submission Guidelines

- [Author Guidelines](https://addicta.com.tr/authorGuidelines): Guidelines for authors submitting manuscripts to Addicta journal following ICMJE standards
- [Review Process](https://addicta.com.tr/reviewProcess): Details on Addicta's double-blind peer review process and editorial decision procedures
- [Research and Publication Ethics](https://addicta.com.tr/publicationEthics): Addicta's publication ethics policies aligned with COPE guidelines and standards
